name: Cali Blaze Tarantula Preroll | Pina Colada
description:
Our essential tarantula joint. One gram of flower, infused with flavor and coated in kief. Heavy hitting, flavor-filled cannabis products to bring that Cali-vibe to your blazing sesh!

Pina Colada is reminiscent of a brief vacation in every puff, carrying you off to sunny shores where relaxation is always the order of the day.
